text: Local residents requested an amendment to the existing parking regulations on the south side of Roxborough Street East, east of Yonge Street. The intent of this amendment is to prohibit stopping within the area located west of the laneway on Roxborough Street East and improve congestion, blockages and sightlines for motorists entering and exiting from Yonge Street. Transportation Services staff have been consulted and have no objection to the proposed amendment.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Prohibited stopping at all times on the south side of Roxborough Street East, between Yonge Street and a point 15 metres east.
